_comment: Hand-written stand-in for Gemini output, used when GEMINI_API_KEY is not set. Route order from route.mjs; every atPhrase appears verbatim in its own text, and every target exists in that room's geometry.

stops.text: Welcome home. Warm red brick, dark metal roofing and stone on the gables, this is Canadian transitional done properly. Just over 2,100 square feet on one level. Let's step inside.
The entry keeps things practical, with a coat closet right by the door, and it opens straight into the living room so the house feels welcoming the moment you arrive.

moves.atPhrase: opens straight into the living room

stops.text: Here's the living room. The gas fireplace anchors the space, and that big south-facing window keeps it bright all afternoon. Wide-plank oak runs underfoot throughout.
The kitchen is built for real cooking. A large central island, a gas range, and windows on two sides, so you're never working in the dark.
Right next door, the dining room. At 267 square feet there's space for a proper table, and the east-facing windows make breakfast here a pleasure.
The hallway ties the whole home together, with every bedroom and bathroom just off it.
The master bedroom sits in its own quiet corner, with windows along the west wall for soft evening light and an ensuite right through here.
The ensuite is bright and private, with a small high window that lets the light in and keeps the view out.
Bedroom two is a comfortable size, with a north window and its own closet. Perfect for a child, a guest, or a home office.
And finally, the main bath, with a tub and shower combination finished in the same warm, clean style as the rest of the house. Thanks for touring with us.
